clues.text: Jesus carried His own cross out to this place, which has a Hebrew name.
Soldiers brought Jesus here after making Simon of Cyrene carry His cross.
Here Jesus was offered wine mixed with gall, but after tasting it He refused to drink.
At this place Jesus was crucified between two others, one on each side of Him.
Here soldiers divided the garments of Jesus by casting lots, then sat down to keep watch over Him.
Many Jews read Pilate's sign over Jesus, because this place of crucifixion was near the city.
Near the spot where Jesus was crucified was a garden holding a new tomb.
